brief: Explore three distinct design directions for Velagapudi Mahendra's portfolio (CS & Data Science Researcher-Builder): Lab Obsidian, Modern Editorial Monograph, and Minimal Kinetic Studio.

candidates.name: Lab Obsidian (Technical Systems & AI Research)
candidates.concept: Precision scientific lab instrument emphasizing empirical verification, live telemetry, and systems thinking over decorative gimmicks.
candidates.typography: Space Grotesk (headings) + Inter (body) + JetBrains Mono (telemetry & code)

candidates.name: Swiss Monograph (Scholar & Fellow)
candidates.concept: Academic treatise meets modern Stripe Press publication; tailored for prestigious scholarship review panels (MEXT/Honjo) and research fellowships.
candidates.typography: Newsreader / Fraunces (editorial serif headings) + Inter (grotesque body) + JetBrains Mono (metadata)

candidates.name: Linear Studio (Minimal Kinetic Builder)
candidates.concept: High-velocity product engineering craft inspired by Linear and Vercel; focused on shipped software, dense scan-ability, and crisp contrast.
candidates.typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (geometric sans) + JetBrains Mono (command bar & metrics)
